items.question: What is the minimum age an applicant must be to apply for a private school licence in the Northern Emirates?
items.gold: The applicant must be at least 25 years old.
items.fact: Northern Emirates private school licence applicant minimum age is 25

items.question: Can a private school in the UAE raise its educational fees without first getting approval from the Ministry of Education or the local education authority?
items.gold: No, private schools cannot raise or change educational fees without prior approval from MoE or the local education authority.
items.fact: Private schools need MoE or local authority approval to change fees
